sentences.text:
---- Respondents
For Petitioner : Mr. Prahlad Panda, Advocate For State : Mr. Vinay Pandey, Dy. Advocate General
Hon'ble Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 11/07/2024
1.
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that land of petitioner was acquired and the proceedings was initiated in the year 2003 under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The amount of compensation which is calculated is less than what for which petitioner is entitled.

He contended that though proceedings were initiated in the year 2003, however, award was passed only on 07.06.2024 and by that time, guideline of market value of land came in force in the year 2019-20 and, therefore,
petitioner is entitled for some more amount of compensation through recomputation of amount of compensation.

sentences.text: Learned State counsel raises an objection with regard to maintainability of the writ petition and submits that grievance of petitioner is that he has been awarded less amount of compensation and award is passed under the provision of Land Acquisition Act, 1894, hence, petitioner is having efficacious alternate remedy to file an application under Section 18 of the Act of 1894.

3. In the aforementioned facts of the case, as petitioner is not disputing the fact that, land acquisition proceedings for acquiring the land of petitioner is initiated under the Act of 1894 nature of grievance raised, seeking more amount of compensation and also considering provisions under Section 18 of the Act of 1894, I am not inclined to entertain this writ petition as petitioner is having efficacious alternate remedy to file appropriate proceeding before appropriate forum under the Act of 1894.
4. Accordingly, writ petition is dismissed reserving liberty with the petitioner to file appropriate proceeding before appropriate forum in accordance with law.
In case, petitioner files appropriate proceedings before appropriate forum, the same shall be considered and decided expeditiously.
